scope: Factorise the five listed forms; common-factor extraction also supports 6131:6b:02. Algebraic fractions, completing the square and solving equations are separate objectives.

required_forms.limitation: The generator includes both one-letter and two-letter forms. Two-letter coverage exists across seeds, not in every draw or renewal.

guarantee: Each listed factorisation form has direct coverage across its generator family. Difference-of-squares draws can use one or two letters; a deck does not guarantee every form in each generated test. Recognising expressions that cannot be factorised is not assessed by these recipes.
review_status: Independent review found direct five-form coverage; scoped repairs awaiting re-review.
